package.description: Edit, annotate, convert and AI chat with PDF anytime, anywhere!

en-US.description: Edit, annotate, convert and AI chat with PDF anytime, anywhere!
en-US.longDescription: UPDF is a powerful PDF software that enables you to easily view, annotate, edit, convert, OCR, and organize PDF files. Its intuitive design allows users to perform tasks effortlessly, even without specialized skills. With advanced functionalities aimed at enhancing user experience, UPDF serves as an invaluable tool for business professionals, students, and anyone requiring PDF document manipulation. Integrated with AI technology, UPDF now offers even more robust capabilities, including summarization, translation, and explanation of PDFs.
en-US.name: UPDF

zh-CN.description: 新一代 AI 智能 PDF 编辑器
zh-CN.longDescription: Windows 版本 UPDF 软件是一款简洁好用的桌面端 PDF 软件，可帮助您轻松查看、注释和管理 PDF 文件。UPDF 的界面设计使您无需任何技能即可灵活地执行任务。它也是商务专业人士、学生和任何需要处理 PDF 文档的人的优质选择。与人工智能技术相结合，UPDF 现在提供了更强大的功能，包括 AI 总结 PDF、AI 翻译 PDF、AI 解释 PDF 等等。
zh-CN.name: UPDF
